why: A pointer into each game's own ROM is read by the data there (32 bytes the same: a table both games have). Where a table's end is followed by other bytes in each game, the 32 bytes from its last entries run past it: such a table is named here, by its place in both and its entries' size and count, and a pointer into it is read as its place in it, the entry there the same bytes in both (else the entry differs, and so does the pointer).

tables.name: Handi's bomb's kinds
tables.why: the third kind's type 0x4B (the obstacle Handi drops) keeps at +0x60 the entry of its kind (its +4) in this table: its sprite's animation, HP and collision's region and alliance; Handi's kinds are 2-7 (its version's pair, BN5 0x08106330-0x08106336)
evidence: the obstacle's spawner BN5 0x080CF37E / BN6 0x080CF4EC: +0x60 = the table + 8 x +4 (BN5 0x080CF396-0x080CF3A0, the table's one literal 0x080CF43C / BN6 0x080CF504-0x080CF50E, 0x080CF5B0)
the tables' 64 bytes the same in both but entry 1's HP (BN5 300, BN6 200, +2): the bytes after them are each game's own code and pools

tables.name: the projectile kinds
tables.why: the third kind's type 0 (a shot: 0x0800D928 / 0x0800FAAC spawn it, 0x080C4ABC / 0x080C686E) keeps at +0x4C its kind's entry in this table (its kind its spawner's r0: the Navis' buster's 3, BN5's family 0x16): kinds 0-14 the same in both, each entry the same bytes but 4, 5 and 12 (BN6's own flags, +3), from 15 on each game's own kinds
evidence: the table's word: BN5 0x080C4AD4, BN6 0x080C68F4; its element of kind 0 at +3, the differential's each= item in toadman_sea_elec (BN5 0x080C4803 / BN6 0x080C64EB)
the Dark Soul's buster's shot (darksoul_v1) points at kind 3: BN5 0x080C4824, BN6 0x080C650C, the entry's 12 bytes the same (0405000005ffff01ff000000)

tables.name: the status effect's kinds
tables.why: the fourth kind's type 6 (the effect a status shows over an object: confusion's, kind 0) keeps at +0x60 the entry of its kind (its +4) in this table, its sprite's list and number and the flag its status sets; entries 0 and 1 the same bytes in both, entry 2 not (BN5's sprite 0x2D of list 4, BN6's 0), each game's code after them
evidence: the type's set-up BN5 0x080E0A0C-0x080E0A16 / BN6 0x080E1C58-0x080E1C62: +0x60 = the table + 8 x +4 (its literals BN5 0x080E0B00 / BN6 0x080E1D4C); entries 0 and 1 14 0B 00 00 00 80 00 00 and 14 09 00 00 00 20 00 00 in both
batty_v2 t340: the confusion's effect over MegaMan, kind 0, its +0x60 0x080E09D4 in BN5's, 0x080E1C20 in BN6's

tables.name: the thrown bombs' kinds
tables.why: the third kind's type 8 (a thrown bomb: MiniBomb's) keeps at +0x60 the entry of its kind (its +4) in this table: its collision's region and alliance and its sprite's animation; MiniBomb's kind 0
evidence: the bomb's spawn BN5 0x080C5600-0x080C5608 / BN6 0x080C7470-0x080C7478: +0x60 = the table + 4 x +4 (its one literal BN5 0x080C563C / BN6 0x080C74AC), the same code in both
the tables' first three entries the same in both (0A 05 00 00, 04 05 03 01, 0A 05 01 00); BN5's has seven entries, BN6's four (its fourth BN5's seventh)

tables.name: the spread shot's kinds
tables.why: the third kind's type 0x12 (Spreader's shot and the spread chips') keeps at +0x60 the entry of its kind in this table, three u16 each (its collision's words); Spreader's the fourth (+0x12)
evidence: the shot's spawn, BN5 0x080C6E0E / BN6's twin, its table's literal BN5 0x080C6E24 / BN6 0x080C8360; read at BN5 0x080C6DFA (ldr r3,[r5,#0x60]; ldrb r3,[r3,#1])
the tables' first 43 bytes the same in both (seven entries; BN6's eighth carries 3 where BN5's 0)

tables.name: the pucks' kinds
tables.why: the third kind's type 0x2E (a puck: AirHoc's, AirHocky's) keeps at +0x60 the entry of its kind in this table, three bytes each (its collision's region and alliance, its sprite's animation); AirHoc's the third (+6)
evidence: the puck's setup reads +0x60 from the table's one literal, BN5 0x080CA54C / BN6 0x080CB148
the tables' 12 bytes the same in both (06 01 06, 0A 01 06, 0A 01 06, 12 01 06); code follows them, each game's own

tables.name: the guards' kinds
tables.why: the third kind's type 0x2B (the shield a Guard chip raises before MegaMan: BN5's 0x080CA454 spawns it, BN6's twin 0x080CB050) keeps at +0x64 the entry of its kind in this table, six bytes each (its sprite list 3's 0x1B, two animations, its palette); Guard1-3's the first three (their subfamilies)
evidence: the shield's table: its one literal BN5 0x080CA478 / BN6 0x080CB074
the tables' first three entries the same in both (0C 1B 00 01 0E 00, 0C 1B 02 03 0E 00, 0C 1B 04 05 0E 00); the fourth BN5's 08 01 03 04 04 07 where BN6's 08 00 03 04 04 07

tables.name: the obstacles' kinds (a RockCube's)
tables.why: the cube a RockCube stands, the third kind's type 0x59, keeps at +0x60 the entry of its kind (its +4) in this table: its sprite's animation, HP and collision's region and alliance; a RockCube's kind is 1
evidence: the cube's set-up BN5 0x080D10A8 / BN6 0x080D11E4: +0x60 = the table + 8 x +4 (BN5 0x080D10AA-0x080D10B4, the table's literal 0x080D1148 / BN6 0x080D11E6, 0x080D1284)
the tables' 32 bytes the same in both but entry 3's HP (BN5 306, BN6 356, +2): the bytes after them are each game's own code (BN5 0x080D1088, BN6 0x080D11C4)
